readout_int8lin.readout: one row per question, fresh zero states per row; a row of T ids runs as ceil(T / 16) calls of 'main' (static S = 16): call k gets ids[16k : 16k + 16] with position_ids 0..16k+15; the last call is padded with <|endoftext|> (248044) and the hidden rows of the padded positions are discarded (causal: they cannot reach a real position). The hidden rows [1, 16, 2560] of every call, concatenated and cut to T, are the backbone's final-norm last_hidden_state [T, 2560] the head reads. A row fits when ceil(T / 16) * 16 <= 4095 (the position dim's upper bound; the KV sequence dim is allocated at 4096).

rule.rows: the top 20 rows of the 4B int8lin gate (results/readout_int8lin_pf16_4b.json) by max|dp| (ties: oracle order), then 20 rows drawn from the other rows by source (proportional, largest remainder, at least one per source; numpy default_rng(20261003).choice without replacement inside each source, sources in sorted order) - round 3's procedure with 20 + 20
rule.instrument: fp32 torch on the CPU (parity_decoder_torch.Runner --model kev-4b, 1 thread, bmm depthwise conv), S = 16 chunks from fresh zero states, the 4B oracle's row ids, the 4B fp32 pointer head; per config every body linear and the embedding table carry either the merged checkpoint's fp32 weight or the weight the exporter's quantize_pytorch_model call computes for that variant (the finalized module's dequantization, fp16, cast to fp32)
rule.reproduction_check: before any selection: all_int8_b32's worst max|dp| over the 40 rows >= 0.5 x the int8lin gate transcript's worst over the same rows (0.0601); otherwise stop and report
rule.instrument_floor: exact reproduces the round-4 P1 run (parity_4b/p1_shard*of2.jsonl) of every row bit for bit (probabilities), and every process's swap-back re-run likewise
rule.target: worst max|dp| over the 40 rows <= 0.006 AND the mean over the rows of the row's mean |dp| <= 0.0012 (every option of every question, near-ties included), this instrument
rule.ranking: configs ranked by the mean (ascending; ties: the worst, then the name); the worst is recorded
rule.size: a config's size = the params of the body linears it keeps out of int8 (fp16); the cap = 25 % of the 248 body linears' params; the embedding table's precision does not count against the cap; the estimated main.mlirb = the round-4 fp16 main.mlirb - 2 B x body params + per-linear bytes (fp16 2 B, b32 1 + 2/32, b16 1 + 2/16, aff32 1 + 2/32 + 1/32) - (2 - (1 + 2/32)) B x table params when the table is int8
search: (fixed) exact, all_int8_b32, all_int8_b16, all_int8_affine_b32, embed_int8_only, proj_<kind>_fp16 x 12 (that kind fp16, every other linear int8 b32), layers_<a>-<b>_fp16 x 8 (that four-layer group fp16, the rest b32)
(i) the variants alone: all_int8_b32 / b16 / affine_b32 (0 % fp16)

(ii) kind sets K_j (int8 part b32): the 12 kinds in ranking order, each added while the set stays within the cap (a kind that would cross it is skipped and the walk goes on); K_j = the first j added; K_2, K_3, ... evaluated in order, at most 4
(iii) group sets G_k (int8 part b32): the 8 groups in ranking order; G_k = the top k, k = 2, 3, ... while within the cap
(iv) only if the best variant by mean is not b32: that variant as the int8 part of every K_j / G_k (j, k >= 1) evaluated in (ii)-(iii), ascending size, at most 4
(v) unions K_j + G_k (j, k >= 1, int8 part = the best variant) within the cap, ascending size (ties: smaller k, then smaller j), at most 8
a stage is entered only while no evaluated config within the cap meets the target
(reference, never chosen) at most 2 sets beyond the cap: G_3 and G_4 by ranking (int8 part b32)
rule.choose: among the evaluated configs within the cap that meet the target, the smallest size (ties: the smaller estimated main.mlirb, then the lower mean); if none, the best two within the cap by the ranking (exact and embed_int8_only excluded: they keep the whole body fp32)
rule.embed: then the chosen set(s) with the table int8 (+E), one config each; +E is adopted when its worst exceeds the set's own by at most 0.001
rule.then: the chosen set(s) (and their +E when adopted) are exported (export_decoder.py int8mix / int8lin with --fp16-layers / --fp16-kinds / --quant-block / --quant-scheme / --embed-int8, --model kev-4b) and gated on all 434 rows with the gate's own bar, the 130 held-out rows (never used to choose) and the v2 red arms
